name: goalscope_a_goalheads_faithfulness
command: mkdir -p logs/goalscope && python -m scripts.evaluation.eval_goalscope --model=Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct --mode faithfulness --heads goal --strategy additive_norm --alpha 0.1 |& tee logs/goalscope/a_goalheads_faithfulness.log

name: goalscope_a_goalheads_causality
command: mkdir -p logs/goalscope && python -m scripts.evaluation.eval_goalscope --model=Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct --mode causality --heads goal --strategy additive_norm --alpha 0.1 |& tee logs/goalscope/a_goalheads_causality.log

name: goalscope_a_residual_faithfulness
command: mkdir -p logs/goalscope && python -m scripts.evaluation.eval_residual_patchscope --model=Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct --mode faithfulness --alpha 0.1 --source-agg mean |& tee logs/goalscope/a_residual_faithfulness.log

name: goalscope_a_residual_causality
command: mkdir -p logs/goalscope && python -m scripts.evaluation.eval_residual_patchscope --model=Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct --mode causality --alpha 0.1 --source-agg mean |& tee logs/goalscope/a_residual_causality.log
